description: The run directory hash (force5/ingest/rundir.py, scripts/runs.mjs): the first 8 hex digits of a sha256 over the sorted lines '<path> <sha256 of the file's bytes>\n'. Files are UTF-8 text here so both languages read the same bytes. Tested by force5/ingest/test_squares.py and tests/squares.test.ts.

nested.description: Paths compared byte by byte, not segment by segment: 't/0/1-0' < 't/0/1.5' < 't/0/1/0' < 't/0/10'.

files.t/0/1-0/000.bin: a hyphen sorts before a slash
